scheme_name: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers is a welfare scheme initiated by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2015. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the families of registered construction workers in Haryana. 

The aim is to support the marriage of male workers or their sons. 

The scheme recognizes the financial burden that can arise during marriage ceremonies. 

It seeks to alleviate this burden by providing a monetary benefit. 

The financial assistance offered under this scheme is set at ₹51,000. 

This amount is provided to eligible beneficiaries upon the marriage of a son or male worker. 

The assistance is intended to cover various expenses associated with wedding ceremonies. 

The scheme targets registered construction workers under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996. 

To qualify for this assistance, the applicant must be a registered construction worker. 

The applicant must also have a valid registration with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

In addition, the worker must have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum of one year. 

The age limit for the son of the worker is set at 21 years or above. 

The applicant must provide proof of the marriage, such as a marriage certificate. 

The application process for this scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available at the Haryana Labour Welfare Board offices. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

Along with the application form, the following documents are required: 

1. A copy of the marriage certificate.
2. Proof of identity of the applicant.
3. Proof of registration as a construction worker.
4. Aadhar card of the applicant.
5. Bank account details for the disbursement of funds.

Once the application form is completed and the documents are gathered, the applicant must submit them to the nearest Haryana Labour Welfare Board office. 

The application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of the financial assistance is typically processed within a month of application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

For any inquiries or assistance, applicants can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number: 1800 180 2087. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the welfare of laborers in the state. 

It aims to enhance the living standards of construction workers and their families. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has been proactive in launching various schemes for the welfare of workers. 

This includes health insurance, educational assistance for children, and housing schemes. 

The Shagun scheme specifically addresses the cultural significance of marriage in Indian society. 

It acknowledges the financial strain that families often face during such events. 

By providing this assistance, the government aims to promote social welfare and support family values. 

The scheme also encourages the registration of construction workers with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across Haryana. 

The financial assistance has been instrumental in easing the financial pressures of marriage. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of this scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended recipients. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform workers about the availability of this scheme. 

The scheme is part of Haryana's commitment to labor welfare and social justice. 

It reflects the government's recognition of the contributions of construction workers to the economy. 

The financial assistance is a step towards empowering workers and their families. 

The scheme also promotes the importance of formal registration for workers. 

This ensures that they can access various welfare benefits provided by the government. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for laborers. 

The Shagun scheme is a testament to this commitment. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The government aims to expand the reach of such welfare schemes in the future. 

Overall, the Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers is a significant initiative. 

It provides crucial support to families during important life events. 

The assistance amount of ₹51,000 can make a substantial difference in managing wedding expenses. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's efforts to uplift the working class. 

It aligns with broader social welfare goals aimed at improving living standards. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board remains a key player in implementing this and other welfare initiatives. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's dedication to labor welfare. 

It is designed to ensure that no worker is left behind during significant life events. 

The assistance provided under this scheme is a vital resource for many families in Haryana. 

The government continues to seek ways to enhance and expand welfare programs for laborers. 

The Shagun scheme is an essential part of this ongoing effort. 

It highlights the importance of supporting families in their times of need. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board encourages all eligible workers to take advantage of this scheme. 

By doing so, they can ensure that they receive the financial support they deserve during their son's marriage. 

This initiative not only provides financial relief but also promotes social cohesion and family values. 

The Shagun scheme is a valuable resource for the working class in Haryana.
